$comment: Michael's own apps for ops/apps.mjs. kind electron-release: installs the latest GitHub release (macOS .zip into /Applications, Windows NSIS .exe silently). kind script-repo: clones/pulls the repo into the apps folder, then runs the hook for this OS (.sh with sh, .ps1 with PowerShell) from the repo folder.

apps.name: AppShelf
apps.about: This list as a tray app: install and update these apps (updates itself)

apps.name: WindowsManager
apps.about: Three-zone tab bars and Workspaces (Hammerspoon / AutoHotkey)

apps.name: edge-workspace-switcher
apps.about: Edge workspace switcher extension (synced to ~/.mn-extensions by ext-update)

apps.name: maclikewindows
apps.about: Windows keyboard shortcuts on the Mac (re-applies the Karabiner rules; first install by hand)

apps.name: ScreenShare
apps.about: MacBook as a second display for the Mac mini (rebuilds Host/Viewer; first install by hand)
